title: Full C5 fused loop: rank scaling, conformal K, OR-LSH admission, CASM-K execution, verifier, and closed-loop learning
question: Can a dense outcome-trained CDL Q/K shortlister support calibrated bounded-K admission so exact CASM execution and verification decouple final correctness from M?
hypothesis: The exhaustive target-rank distribution may grow sublinearly with M; split-conformal calibration may yield a held-out shortlist K with the requested coverage; OR-over-tables LSH may retain the target with a smaller reranking population; exact CASM plus independent verification may decouple final selection from CDL Top-1 precision; verified experience writes may improve later routing.
held_constant: dim=16 and exact equality relation across all 16 state bits
fresh target code sampled at every training step
training population M sampled log-uniformly from 8 through 256
two disjoint held-out trial streams for conformal calibration and evaluation
candidate action/index and hidden acceptable-action sets are excluded from router inputs
CASM execution uses the exact relevance_program path; verifier receives public candidate/reference data only
persistent world write is staged with one-step delay before query read
verified writes use the experience: namespace
LSH uses random-hyperplane tables; requested table count is derived from measured rho and capped only for the registered safety limit of 128
gates: CASM exhaustive verifier success must be exactly one candidate per valid trial
No router input may contain target_index or acceptable_actions
Target codes must be unique within each population
Persistent world writes become visible only after a one-step temporal boundary
capability_rule: Do not claim sublinear addressing unless measured routing work exponent is <1 and no table cap binds. Do not claim high absolute capability from retention alone.
coverage_rule: Report calibrated K and empirical held-out coverage separately; conformal guarantee is conditional on exchangeability.
execution_rule: CASM execution count must equal the number of admitted candidates and be bounded by calibrated K.
non_claims: synthetic equality state-addressing does not establish language-level semantic retrieval
arithmetic MACs are not hardware wall-clock speedups
index build cost is reported separately from query cost
online learning results are descriptive unless preregistered causal interventions isolate the update
shortlist_policy: K is obtained from held-out exhaustive target-rank calibration; no beam sweep is used to choose K

arms.name: exhaustive_oracle
arms.intervention: exhaustive exact CASM+verifier scoring of all M candidates

arms.name: dense_cdl_student
arms.intervention: dense Q/K student trained on exhaustive downstream outcomes

arms.name: orlsh_cdl_casm
arms.intervention: same student with OR-over-tables LSH, calibrated K, exact CASM execution and verifier

arms.name: closed_loop_experience
arms.intervention: verified successful candidates update the router and write only to experience namespace

decision_rule.condition: Run the registered exhaustive, dense-student, sparse-funnel, and closed-loop measurements at every M and report the complete endpoint set without outcome-dependent arm selection.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal routing superiority, a hardware speedup, or a general theorem.

decision_rule.condition: A sublinear routing claim requires measured query-routing exponent beta < 1 and no LSH table cap at the evaluated points.
decision_rule.licenses: a bounded empirical scaling statement for this workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: sublinear scaling where the cap binds or where build cost dominates the reported regime.

decision_rule.condition: A conformal coverage statement is conditional on the exchangeability assumptions of the calibration/test split; empirical held-out coverage is reported separately.
decision_rule.licenses: calibrated shortlist coverage under the registered sampling protocol.
decision_rule.does_not_license: distribution-free coverage under arbitrary distribution shift.

interpretation_order: conformal K and empirical held-out coverage
p1 and p2 separation and rho
OR-LSH admission recall and rerank fraction
CASM executed candidate count and verifier selection
closed-loop experience commit rate and online success
query routing versus index-build arithmetic cost
